hook: A drug-carrying DNA aptamer homed in on TROP2 and slowed pancreatic tumor growth in mice.
summary: A short DNA-like aptamer that binds the tumor protein TROP2 was linked to a toxin and shrank pancreatic tumors in mouse models, including patient-derived ones. It also triggered immune signals, and combining it with PD-1 blockade worked better. All evidence is preclinical, so safety and benefit in people are unknown.
title: A TROP2-targeting aptamer enables selective drug delivery and potent antitumor activity in pancreatic cancer.
